findings.title: Attributed false-stability architecture
findings.claim: Across the declared pericope, the focus dwellings can be read in an attributed contextual sequence as a stability architecture: settled places, visible proof, pride and culpability, allied shelter, and the weak spider house expose how apparent security can fail.
findings.mechanism: The supplied HFT trace links 29:37's bodies fixed in their abode to the focus masakin, 29:39's clear proofs and pride, 29:40's offense-linked outcomes, 29:41's chosen protectors and weak house, and 29:43's demand for understanding. Before: the dwellings only preserve evidence of a past disaster. After: they expose a failed security design in which pride and chosen supports can produce an inhabited-looking structure that cannot carry entrusted life.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can follow one attributed stability question from material settlement to relational shelter and the intellectual work needed to recognize its weakness.
findings.containment: This is a legacy-unbound HFT nomination, not an independently verified lexicon result. It remains broader than the declared focus word and leaves the live alternative that 29:41 concerns affiliation independently of the ruins. The ordinary historical dwellings, proofs, and named peoples remain intact.

epistemic.reason: The assigned HFT record has complete supplied anchors but its branch roles are attributed nominations, with several unresolved lexicon descriptors; source qualification therefore remains visible.

findings.title: Attributed counted-case ledger
findings.claim: As an exploratory split-root resonance, the paired names can open a ledger of inspectable cases in which each settled trace is connected to an offense and a distinct outcome.
findings.mechanism: The focus proper name عَادًا carries the supplied non-dominant counting branch only as background pressure; 29:40 then supplies كُلًّا and ذَنۢبِهِ as an independent each-case and offense-outcome frame, while focus تَبَيَّنَ returns the cases to inspectable traces. Before: Aad and Thamud are simply two remembered peoples. After: their named traces can be viewed, exploratorily, as entries in a case ledger.
findings.reader_payoff: The list of peoples and outcomes becomes perceptible as a sequence of inspectable cases without losing its named historical surface.
findings.containment: The dominant proper-name reading remains intact. Counting is not offered as etymology or translation of عَادًا, and the ledger image remains an exploratory formal resonance anchored by the supplied 29:40 sequence.

epistemic.reason: The assigned HFT outlier is fully anchored but explicitly exploratory, uses a non-dominant split-root mapping, and includes unresolved attributed branches.
